gaps: WebSearch here returns a search-engine summary over each result, not raw page text; every snippet field quotes that summary, so a word may be paraphrased even where the house's page is the source. Prices matched the guide of 26 September in every case, which supports them.

No fall 2026 dinner or breakfast card surfaced: no search showed a new dish or a dish gone since 26 September. Every à la carte price found ($13 soups, $17 tartare, $22 claws, $26 Sardou, $27 Hussarde, $25 shrimp and grits, $31 Pecan Gulf Fish, $32 duck waffle, $29 poussin, $36 redfish, $38 papillote, $120 Chateaubriand, $14 desserts) agrees with the pack.

The dinner tasting: the 80th anniversary card now ends on Bananas Foster with Congregation coffee, while an earlier snippet (second-pass.md) ended it on The Snickers with Banyuls. Which dessert is poured tonight is a lineup question; the duck course on both live snippets is the Hazelnut-Crusted Duck with winter squash, an autumn plate not in the pack.
Traditional Breakfast: courses two and four were not in any snippet this run (the guide's card has them).
Thanksgiving 2026: the full course list, the desserts and the children's $35 menu were not printed; the date conflicts between November 26, 2026 and a stale Thursday, November 27 line.

Christmas Eve 2026, Reveillon 2026, New Year's Eve 2026 and Breakfast with Santa 2026: no 2026 card surfaced. The Christmas Eve dishes found are credited to Executive Chef Ryan Hacker and are a past year's; the Santa event snippet carries a December 21 date.
Restaurant Week: the June 8 to 14 menu prints no year; Eggs Benedict and Blackberry Crepes appear only there.
Bubbles at Brennan's: Creole Spiced Nuts ($6 in the pack) and Popcorn Shrimp ($15 in the pack) did not appear in this run's snippets; Roost snack hours conflict within one snippet.
Dessert: New Orleans Bread Pudding, The Snickers, Pineapple Tarte Tatin and Blackberry Trifle prices were not re-seen this run (the pack holds them from the guide).

Breakfast and lunch: Eggs Owen, Crab and Corn Omelette, Creole-Spiced Hanger Steak, Framboise French Toast, Creole Tomato Tostada and the sides were not re-seen this run; Gulf Fish Amandine sits only in the house gallery.
No original 1946 menu or story of individual dishes beyond Bananas Foster (1951) and the Breakfast at Brennan's origin surfaced.
